This app finds explicit images on your screen and draws a blur over them. All processing happens on your device.

This app never gives a 100% guarantee. It will miss some images and it will blur others by mistake.\n\nIt is not a security tool — it is a self-control tool. If you set out to bypass it, you will succeed. The goal is friction, not prevention.

The app has no internet access at all. This is not just a promise: the INTERNET permission is not declared in the manifest, so the system technically cannot let the app reach the network.\n\nScreen images are never stored or sent anywhere. No account, no sign-up.

Android forbids the following, and we cannot work around it:

• Screen recording consent is requested every single time
• Protection stops when the screen locks; you must turn it back on after unlocking
• It does not work inside banking apps or password managers
• The screen-recording indicator is always visible at the top
